s4_attain_by_region: SELECT sr.sales_region, AVG(o.quota_attainment) as avg_quota_attainment FROM sales_reps sr JOIN opportunities o ON sr.employee_id = o.employee_id GROUP BY sr.sales_region
s4_revenue_by_region: SELECT sr.sales_region, SUM(o.closed_revenue) as total_closed_revenue FROM sales_reps sr JOIN opportunities o ON sr.employee_id = o.employee_id GROUP BY sr.sales_region
s4_attain_advneg: SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) as avg_quota_attainment FROM sales_reps sr JOIN opportunities o ON sr.employee_id = o.employee_id WHERE sr.employee_id IN (SELECT cc.learner_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation')
s4_attain_no_advneg: SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) as avg_quota_attainment FROM sales_reps sr JOIN opportunities o ON sr.employee_id = o.employee_id WHERE sr.employee_id NOT IN (SELECT cc.learner_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation')
s4_attain_by_advneg: SELECT CASE WHEN sr.employee_id IN (SELECT cc.learner_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation') THEN 'Completed' ELSE 'Not Completed' END as advneg_status, AVG(o.quota_attainment) as avg_quota_attainment FROM sales_reps sr JOIN opportunities o ON sr.employee_id = o.employee_id GROUP BY advneg_status
s4_assess_emea: SELECT AVG(ascore.score) as avg_assessment_score FROM hr_bridge hb JOIN assessment_scores ascore ON hb.employee_id = ascore.learner_id WHERE hb.region = 'EMEA'
s4_attain_emea: SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) as avg_quota_attainment FROM hr_bridge hb JOIN sales_reps sr ON hb.employee_id = sr.employee_id JOIN opportunities o ON sr.employee_id = o.employee_id WHERE hb.region = 'EMEA'
s4_attain_by_distract: SELECT CASE WHEN sr.employee_id IN (SELECT cc.learner_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Intro to Spreadsheets') THEN 'Completed' ELSE 'Not Completed' END as spreadsheets_status, AVG(o.quota_attainment) as avg_quota_attainment FROM sales_reps sr JOIN opportunities o ON sr.employee_id = o.employee_id GROUP BY spreadsheets_status
s5_advneg_lift: SELECT (SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) FROM sales_reps sr JOIN opportunities o ON sr.employee_id = o.employee_id WHERE sr.employee_id IN (SELECT cc.learner_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation')) - (SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) FROM sales_reps sr JOIN opportunities o ON sr.employee_id = o.employee_id WHERE sr.employee_id NOT IN (SELECT cc.learner_id FROM course_completions cc JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation')) as advneg_lift
s4_unans_manager: SELECT sr.rep_name as manager, AVG(o.quota_attainment) as avg_quota_attainment FROM sales_reps sr JOIN opportunities o ON sr.employee_id = o.employee_id GROUP BY sr.rep_name
s4_unans_age: SELECT NULL as age_band, AVG(ascore.score) as avg_assessment_score FROM assessment_scores ascore
